text:
tom_sales: heads up — Starlight POC is blocked provisioning dedicated GPU pool in us-west1. They hit 'quota_exceeded' and an AZ affinity mismatch when creating reservation.
leah_cs: ouch. do we have the exact API error? screenshot or logs?
tom_sales: paste from their CLI:
```
ERROR: reservation create failed: 409 Conflict - quota_exceeded
{"code":409,"message":"Requested GPU quota (A100) exceeds project limit in us-west1. affinityZone 'us-west1-b' not available for requested reservation"}
```
They tried to pin to us-west1-b for latency.
devon_engineer: two separate issues: one is quota, one is AZ affinity. If their reservation is region-scoped but template asks for zone-scoped affinity we reject with that second message. Can you confirm their reservation config? (paste below)
tom_sales: they sent this:
```
reservation: {
  capacity: 8,
  gpu_type: "A100",
  region: "us-west1",
  affinity: { "zone": "us-west1-b" },
  reserved_until: "2026-10-01"
}
```
we flagged affinity mismatch in our UI too.
leah_cs: ok. quick triage — do they need zone affinity? can we suggest region-level reservation + soft-affinity (best-effort) so we don't block capacity? also we should check cloud provider quotas for their project id.
maria_sales: customer expects <50ms p95. they specifically asked for AZ pinning to avoid cross-az hop. any mitigation timeline if we remove strict zone pin? also pricing question — does zone reservation cost more? need to reply to procurement.
devon_engineer: zone pinning isn't free — it reduces scheduler flexibility so we only allow it when capacity guaranteed. For now propose: 1) create region reservation (us-west1) without explicit zone, 2) set model placement preference to prefer us-west1-b when available (soft-affinity), 3) if they need strict AZ SLA we escalate to capacity planning and commit extra reserved nodes (longer lead time).
anna_ops: infra-bot shows spike on allocation attempts:
`infra-bot: [1839124720] capacity-allocator: 6/8 A100 in us-west1 currently claimed by other commitments`
so quota will be the gating factor.
leah_cs: @tom_sales can you ask the customer for their cloud project id (if using private) or confirm if they're on our dedicated tenancy? if it's their cloud, quota bump request to provider needed; if it's our pool we can move nodes but need approval.
tom_sales: they say using Redwood Dedicated (we provision). customer id ST-101. they want start next week.
maria_sales: timeline is urgent — sales asked for go/no-go by EOD tomorrow to keep the deal on track.
devon_engineer: actionable plan I suggest:
- Option A (fast): remove zone affinity, create region reservation for 8 A100 in us-west1, enable soft-affinity to prefer us-west1-b. Can do within 4-6 hours if capacity freed.
- Option B (strict AZ SLA): open capacity planning + procurement for dedicated AZ pinned nodes — 2–3 days plus confirmation, potential commit/price delta.
I'll run capacity check and post back.
infra-bot: [1839124788] deployment-event: created reservation-request ST-101-req-244, status: pending-capacity
anna_ops: I'm opening an internal ticket to shift unutilized pool from dev accounts — ETA 6–12h if approvals quick (ticket #INFR-7531)
leah_cs: also note customer sent security questions about dedicated host isolation and audit logs — can someone from infra confirm we can provide KMS-backed keys and audit retention 365d? that's part of contract.
devon_engineer: yes we can provide KMS integration and exportable audit logs. I'll add a short note for legal: isolation is by VPC + dedicated pool tagging, details in the SOC doc.
maria_sales: perfect. also quick pricing Q: if we go Option A (region, soft-affinity) will price be same as strict AZ? need ballpark change for procurement reply.
devon_engineer: price impact minimal for region soft-affinity. Strict AZ SLA likely +10–25% depending on node commitment and reserved capacity term. exact quote from finance.
anna_ops: got approval to reclaim 4 A100 from a non-prod pool — starting transfer now.
infra-bot: [1839124852] capacity-allocator: transfer started for 4 A100 -> us-west1 pool
tom_sales: I'll tell the customer: propose region reservation + soft-affinity as near-term, escalate strict AZ if they insist. Also ask for their procurement lead contact. cc @maria_sales for pricing.
leah_cs: can we schedule a 30m swarming call in 1h to finalize? prefer devon + anna + tom + customer.
maria_sales: yes schedule pls — I'm on standby.
tom_sales: scheduled meeting 1h from now. tagging customer rep to confirm. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
